title: Maximum residue level for mepiquat
summary: EU to increase mepiquat MRL in honey from early 2027
update: The European Union (EU) will increase the maximum residue level (MRL) for mepiquat in honey from 0.05 to 1.5 mg/kg.
what_changing: The EU will increase the maximum residue level (MRL) for mepiquat in honey from 0.05 (the limit of determination, LOD) to 1.5 mg/kg. (The LOD is the lowest level that can be detected using the most modern and reliable analytical methods.)
why: Following an application for a change of MRL by the producer of mepiquat, the European Food Safety Authority evaluated the requested change and concluded that increasing the MRL would not pose a risk for consumers ( EFSA 2026 ).
timeline: The new MRL for mepiquat in honey is expected to apply from early 2027.
background:
In June 2025 the EU raised the MRL for mepiquat on grapes from 0.02 mg/kg (LOD) to 5 mg/kg (Regulation 2025/1164 ), in line with the Codex Alimentarius MRL (CXL), as it was not considered to be a concern for human safety.

MRLs are set in accordance with the rules set out in Regulation 396/2005 . For information on current MRLs for other substances, please consult the EU Pesticide Residues database .
